questions.markdown:
Sketch the signal

$$
x(t)=u(t+1)+2u(t)-u(t-3)-2u(t-5).
$$

Find and sketch the even and odd part of the signal.

Classify the following signals into energy, power or neither of these. Also calculate energy and power of these signals.

(i) 

$$
e^{3t}u(-t),
$$

(ii) 

$$
e^{-2|t|}
$$

Estimate the step response of the LTI system with impulse response

$$
h(t)=\begin{cases}e^{2t}, & t<0\\ e^{-3t}, & t>0\end{cases}.
$$

A typical multipath channel has direct path and a reflection path with delay 2 units.
The model is then 

$$
y[n]=x[n]-ax[n-2]
$$

 where 

$$
x[n]
$$

 is transmitted signal and 

$$
y[n]
$$

 is received signal. Estimate the impulse response of a causal inverse system to recover 

$$
x[n]
$$

 from 

$$
y[n]
$$

. Is such inverse system practically stable?

Sketch the DF I and DF II implementations for the following systems described by difference equation

$$
2y[n]+y[n-1]-2y[n-3]=6x[n-1]+4x[n-2]
$$

Estimate the convolution of the following signals using Fourier Transform

$$
x_1(t)=te^{-t}u(t)
$$

$$
x_2(t)=te^{-2t}u(t)
$$

Determine the DTFS coefficient of the following signal using method of inspection

$$
x[n]=\cos\left(\frac{8\pi}{19}n+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)
$$

Determine the Fourier Transforms of the following signal using tables of transforms and properties

$$
x(t)=\cos(2\pi t)e^{-t}u(t)
$$

$$

Consider

$$
x(t)=\left(\frac{1}{800\pi}\right)x_1(t)x_2(t),
$$

where 

$$
x_1(t)=\frac{\sin(400\pi t)}{\pi t}
$$

 and 

$$
x_1(t)=\frac{\sin(600\pi t)}{\pi t}
$$

Determine the Nyquist rate. Plot the spectrum of sampled signal at Nyquist rate of sampling.

questions.markdown:
Determine the transfer function, difference equation representation of the system with the impulse response

$$
h[n]=(1/3)^n u[n]+\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{n-2}u[n-1].
$$

Use the method of partial fraction expansion to obtain the time domain signal for the function

$$
X(z)=\frac{z^2-3z}{z^2+\frac{3}{2}z-1},\; \frac{1}{2}<|z|<2.
$$

Determine the time domain signal for the function

$$
X(s)=\frac{4s^2+8s+10}{(s+2)(s^2+2s+5)}
$$

with the ROC

(i) 

$$
\operatorname{Re}(s)<-2
$$

(ii) 

$$
\operatorname{Re}(s)>-1
$$

(iii) 

$$
-2<\operatorname{Re}(s)<-1
$$
